notes: What the session-handoff context hook does when a conversation grows large (one file for this machine, saved as environments/handoff.json). mode "ask" (default): Claude offers in one line to save the work state to handoff.md in the ticket's folder and continue after /clear; "auto": Claude saves it without asking and says so; "never": the hook stays silent (saving still works on request, e.g. 'zapisz stan'). thresholdTokens: context size at which it speaks; repeatTokens: how much more the context must grow before it speaks again. statusLine: "qa-agent" sets the QA_Agent status line, whose ctx part turns green, purple (from 100k), yellow (from thresholdTokens) and red with /clear! (from thresholdTokens + 20k), so you see when to hand off; "own" leaves your own status line alone.
